lines.zh: 我摆动叶子，像海草在漂。
lines.en: I sway my leaves like drifting weed.

lines.zh: 我的鳍太小，游得很吃力。
lines.en: My fins are small; swimming is an effort.

lines.zh: 贴着海草走，别人才看不见我。
lines.en: Beside the seagrass, no one notices me.

lines.zh: 我顺着一股暖流滑过去。
lines.en: I slide along a warm current.

lines.zh: 叶子一摆，我就往前挪一点。
lines.en: One sway of leaves moves me forward.

lines.zh: 我假装自己是一片海草。
lines.en: I pretend to be a patch of seagrass.

lines.zh: 深温水海洋里，我慢慢漂。
lines.en: I drift slowly through the deep lukewarm ocean.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴卷着一小段海草。
lines.en: My tail curls around a bit of weed.

lines.zh: 别看我游得慢，我从不迷路。
lines.en: Slow as I swim, I never lose my way.

lines.zh: 我把身体斜过来，像枝条。
lines.en: I tilt my body like a leafy twig.

lines.zh: 温带浅海的水清得能看远。
lines.en: Temperate shallows are clear enough to see far.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙面滑，尽量不出声。
lines.en: I skim the sand and keep quiet.

lines.zh: 一片叶子掉了，我照样游。
lines.en: A leaf fell off; I swim on anyway.

lines.zh: 我游得一晃一晃，像水草。
lines.en: I wobble along exactly like waterweed.
I hang among the seagrass, motionless.

lines.zh: 我的叶子跟海草一个颜色。
lines.en: My leaves match the seagrass exactly.

lines.zh: 一条大鱼游过，没看见我。
lines.en: A big fish passes without seeing me.
I hold still, not even flicking a fin.
My long snout can only sip tiny creatures.
Light shifts back and forth on the seagrass bed.
I curl the tip of my tail slowly.

lines.zh: 深温水海洋安静得吓人。
lines.en: The deep lukewarm ocean is eerily quiet.
I spread all my leafy fins wide.
A little shrimp lands on my head.

lines.zh: 我其实很紧张，一直绷着。
lines.en: I am actually tense, always holding tight.

lines.zh: 我数着从我叶间漏下的光。
lines.en: I count the light leaking between my leaves.
The surface is far; it is safe here.

lines.zh: 我慢慢呼吸，鳃一张一合。
lines.en: I breathe slowly, gills opening and closing.
You have seen me; I am a little scared.
I am a piece of seagrass, honestly.

lines.zh: 你眼睛怎么一直盯着我。
lines.en: Why do your eyes keep fixed on me?
I am not kelp; do not pick me.

lines.zh: 你靠近时，我的叶子全僵了。
lines.en: As you near, all my leaves go stiff.

lines.zh: 我的伪装在你面前没用。
lines.en: My disguise fails in front of you.
The net in your hand frightens me.
I shrink slowly into the seagrass.

lines.zh: 你笑什么，我长得很怪吗？
lines.en: What are you smiling at? Do I look odd?

lines.zh: 我这条小鱼，只值两点血。
lines.en: This little fish has only two health.
Your boots look huge down here.
Do not blink, or I will slip away.
One of my leaves was knocked off.
Two health is all I have; I cannot take it.
The pain makes me forget my disguise.
There is a tear in my fin.

lines.zh: 别打了，我只有两片叶子大。
lines.en: Stop; I am only two leaves big.
I curl up like a rotting leaf.

lines.zh: 这一下把我打进了沙里。
lines.en: That blow drove me into the sand.
I swim away crooked and unsteady.
The whole ocean wants to eat me.
Hidden in the weeds, I still ache.
Is there a tiny bug in your palm?

lines.zh: 我不吃海带，我只吃小虫。
lines.en: I do not eat kelp, only tiny creatures.
That tiny motion draws me nearer.

lines.zh: 你晃手指的样子像小虾。
lines.en: Your wiggling finger looks like a shrimp.
I only dare to watch from a distance.

lines.zh: 你撒下的碎屑沉下来了。
lines.en: The crumbs you scattered are sinking.
I come one inch and retreat two.

lines.zh: 这么小的我，也只贪一口。
lines.en: Even someone this small wants one bite.
Do not move suddenly; I will bolt.
Your bait is right by the seagrass.
Your bump sent me tumbling in a circle.
All my leaves are in disarray.
Careful; my fins are paper-thin.
One bump and I shed a few leaves.
The splash carries me far away.
I hit the seagrass before stopping.
Your leg touched me; I must hide.

lines.zh: 我这么小，撞你也没感觉。
lines.en: So small, bumping you is nothing.
Your bump ruined my disguise.
After the bump I hide in the weeds.

lines.zh: 我们两条并排挂在草上。
lines.en: The two of us hang side by side.

lines.zh: 叶海龙跳舞，就是一起漂。
lines.en: Seadragons dance by drifting together.

lines.zh: 我把叶子贴到它的叶子上。
lines.en: I press my leaves against its leaves.

lines.zh: 深温水海洋是我们的家。
lines.en: The deep lukewarm ocean is our home.

lines.zh: 别打扰，我们在慢慢转圈。
lines.en: Do not disturb; we are turning slowly.
The eggs will be carried off by the current.

lines.zh: 我们的颜色正好配成一对。
lines.en: Our colors make a matching pair.

lines.zh: 小叶子龙以后会藏满海草。
lines.en: Little dragons will fill this seagrass later.
We are both small, but quite sincere.

lines.zh: 你的灯照得我们不敢动。
lines.en: Your lamp freezes us both.

lines.zh: 我用长嘴叼起一小块石头。
lines.en: My long snout lifts a small stone.
This thing is a bit bigger than me.

lines.zh: 我用尾巴卷住它拖着走。
lines.en: I curl my tail around it and drag.

lines.zh: 太沉了，我差点被拽下去。
lines.en: So heavy it nearly dragged me down.
I hide it beneath the seagrass.
Picking things up is not my strength.
This thing glitters; very suspicious.

lines.zh: 我一松嘴，它就沉下去了。
lines.en: I let go and it sinks away.

lines.zh: 我叼着它游得歪歪扭扭。
lines.en: Carrying it, I swim crookedly.
Take it back; I want no trouble.

lines.zh: 我盯上了那只会动的小虫。
lines.en: I have my eye on that wriggling bug.
Small as I am, I am still a dragon.

lines.zh: 前面有东西在动，我要查。
lines.en: Something moves ahead; I will check.
I have fixed on a little shrimp.

lines.zh: 我把叶子张开，显得更大。
lines.en: I spread my leaves to look bigger.
Who dares come near my seagrass?

lines.zh: 我盯住那个晃动的影子。
lines.en: I fix on that swaying shadow.
I guard this patch of water.
The target is tiny; my focus is total.

lines.zh: 我在心里数到三就出手。
lines.en: I count to three, then I strike.
I slowly line my snout up with it.

lines.zh: 这东西比我小，我就不怕。
lines.en: It is smaller than me, so I am brave.
I flick my leaves as a warning.
Even the deep has my territory.
I creep closer along the seagrass.

lines.zh: 我的长嘴已经对准了它。
lines.en: My long snout is aimed at it already.
I swim slowly, but never off course.

lines.zh: 我用叶子遮住自己的影子。
lines.en: I use my leaves to hide my shadow.
When it flees, I chase a short way.
My little fins beat desperately.

lines.zh: 我们是龙，追东西要有样子。
lines.en: We dragons must chase with dignity.
My target is the same green as the weed.

lines.zh: 我绕了一个小圈包过去。
lines.en: I swing a small circle to cut it off.

lines.zh: 这股水流把它往我这送。
lines.en: The current is bringing it toward me.

lines.zh: 我停下来，等它自己露头。
lines.en: I stop and wait for it to show.
Chase too hard and my leaves fall off.

lines.zh: 我尽量不惊动整片海草。
lines.en: I try not to disturb the whole bed.
One bite is enough; I am not greedy.

lines.zh: 我把自己缩成一片海草，等它走。
lines.en: I shrink into a blade of seagrass and wait it out.
I jab it with my long snout.

lines.zh: 这就是叶海龙的全力一击。
lines.en: That is a seadragon's full-force strike.
I bite and hold, though it is light.
Do not laugh; a dragon has pride.
Every leaf on me stands upright.
That charge spun me around too.

lines.zh: 我打得很准，就是没力气。
lines.en: My aim is true; my strength is not.
Step back; I am still angry.
Even a small dragon's bite can hurt.
I swing my tail and miss completely.
After striking, I hide in the weeds.
With two health, I cannot fight long.
Laugh if you like; I will bite again.
I cling to your finger, trembling.
I swim out from between the seagrass.
Born looking like a single leaf.

lines.zh: 深温水海洋是我的摇篮。
lines.en: The deep lukewarm ocean is my cradle.
The two of us drift down together.
My leaves are still soft and wet.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋刚裂开，我就在这。
lines.en: The egg just cracked; here I am.
Temperate shallow light falls on me.
First I find seagrass to hide in.

lines.zh: 这么小的龙，要先学会藏。
lines.en: A dragon this small must learn to hide.

lines.zh: 我一张嘴，只吸到一口水。
lines.en: I open my mouth and gulp only water.
The seagrass sand is fine and soft.
I fold my leaves and pose as weed.

lines.zh: 周围的鱼都比我大得多。
lines.en: Every fish around me is much bigger.
From today, this patch is mine.

lines.zh: 海草床的沙还在我身上。
lines.en: The seagrass sand is still on me.

lines.zh: 这窝里出生，我先学会装草。
lines.en: Born in this nest, I first learned to pose as weed.

lines.zh: 水烫起来，我的叶子卷了边。
lines.en: The water boils; my leaf edges curl.
Flung from the shallows onto dry sand.

lines.zh: 水灌进鳃里，我抓紧一片海草。
lines.en: Water floods my gills; I cling to a blade of seagrass.

lines.zh: 冲击把我和海草一起掀翻。
lines.en: The blast flips me and the seagrass.
An arrow grazes one of my leaves.

lines.zh: 紫光一晃，我的颜色淡了。
lines.en: Violet light fades the color from me.

lines.zh: 这片海草里没有一只小虫。
lines.en: Not one tiny creature lives in this weed.

lines.zh: 雷落进浅海，我全身发僵。
lines.en: Lightning hits the shallows and I stiffen.

lines.zh: 没有水，我的叶子立刻干了。
lines.en: Without water, my leaves dry at once.
